exposure: Multiparous women with singleton cephalic term pregnancy without scar
Nulliparous women with singleton cephalic term pregnancy and planned CD
Nulliparous women with singleton cephalic term pregnancy
cohort: 91,015 women who delivered at ≥24 weeks of gestation at a large tertiary obstetric center in Shanghai, China from 2011 to 2016
finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate decreased from 49.0% in 2011 to 40.6% in 2016.
